## RSV VACCINE
Vaccination is recommended to protect adults aged 75 years and older from
severe Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infection. Vaccination consists of
a single dose of either available vaccine formulation (GlaxoSmithKline or
Pfizer).
People 60-74 years may recieve the vaccine if they have a risk factor for
severe RSV disease.
